card: Replaces an obsolete TODO in functional test wallet_send.py with a test exercising send RPC behavior when fee_rate falls below the mempool minimum fee. It tests that generated transactions either fail testmempoolaccept or stay unconfirmed in the wallet without entering the mempool. This cleans up stale test code from PR #16378 and adds regression coverage for this wallet fee edge case.
evidence: PR description: 'wallet_send.py had a commented-out TODO from the original send PR (#16378) about returning the hex when the fee rate is below the mempool minimum. The commented code was stale; estimate_mode="sat/b" no longer exists.'
problem: The wallet_send.py test contained an obsolete commented-out TODO from PR #16378 referencing an estimate_mode option that no longer exists, leaving behavior untested when an explicit fee_rate is lower than mempoolminfee.

risk.why: A flaw in this test could cause CI test failures or false passes without affecting node runtime behavior.

summary: Replaces a stale commented-out TODO in the functional test wallet_send.py with an active test case. The new subtest exercises send RPC behavior when an explicit fee_rate is below mempoolminfee, checking both add_to_wallet=false and add_to_wallet=true cases.
